input_file.description: Path to source dictionary file. Required. Must be one of: .bgl, .tei, .dct, .ifo (StarDict).

output_file.description: Path to target dictionary file. Required. Must be one of: .index (DICT), .dic (PlainText), .ifo (StarDict).

help.description: Print help message and exit. Overrides other options. Corresponds to '-h' or '-?'.

version.description: Show version information and exit. Corresponds to '-v'.
